svg.title: Global Peppol ecosystem
svg.desc: One universal integration engine with UAE PINT AE and Oman PINT OM country profiles, and further country profiles that plug into the same engine, connected through Peppol.
svg.text: Country profiles on one universal engine, connected across borders.
Ringed markers show where profiles plug in.
Peppol interoperability complements, and does not replace, national tax-authority requirements.
